Subject: Clarify privdeploy pricing options (retainer vs bulk discount)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We liked the private deployment model but procurement needs a clearer comparison between: (a) a fixed SRE/ops retainer + platform fee amortized over 12 months, and (b) a higher up-front platform fee with a steeper bulk-discount on node/seat pricing (effectively capex vs opex tradeoff).

Two asks: can you send a simple workback that shows total TCO over 12/24/36 months for the two options, and what concessions (implementation credits, onboarding SRE hours, response-time SLAs) you can include to bridge our internal approval? We have a standard 3rd-party procurement timeline — final decision by end of July.

Also looping Kai from procurement who will manage the contract redlines.

Appreciate a one-pager and a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Marta

I’m looping Rishi (pricing) and Irene (deploy/ops) to draft the workback and propose what we can include as onboarding credits and SLA sweeteners.

Folks —

Marta wants a concise TCO and a concession schedule we can commit to by EOW. I started a matrix (attached) with their baseline ask: 3 sites, 24 nodes steady-state, expected token volume ~1.2B/month at p50. Key levers:
- Platform fee amortization (monthly vs upfront)
- Ops retainer (on-call SRE hours, dedicated 0.5 FTE vs on-demand)
- Onboarding credits (implementation hours)
- Failover SLA / response-time (we can sweeten with a 4hr P1 on-call for 6 months)

Can Rishi and Irene suggest ranges we can offer (percent off, credit hours) that still hit our margin floor? Grace — if you have historical acceptance thresholds for similar mid-market health accounts, paste them in.

I attached a quick spreadsheet: pricing_workback.xlsx

Thanks — I need something we can send to Marta and Kai by Thu morning so we can schedule the call.

—Marissa

Attachments: pricing_workback.xlsx (spreadsheet with baseline and placeholders)
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 11:21:00 -0700
From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Subject: RE: INTERNAL: ClearStream — workback + concession options (need numbers)

Marissa —

Quick proposal (numbers are high-level, see attached updated workback):

Baseline commercial assumptions (12-month):
- Platform fee: $350k annual amortized (Option A monthly = $29.2k/mo; Option B upfront = $320k discounted if paid up-front)
- Node unit price (post-discount): Option A: $X/node-hour; Option B: -18% on nodes if upfront commit
- Ops retainer: Option A: standard 0.5 FTE @ $120k annual ($60k pass-through) -> we can offer $20k onboarding credit; Option B: reduce retainer to 0.25 FTE if they take upfront option and 24-month commit
- Implementation/onboarding credits: up to 120 hours SRE/eng credits for Option B (spread across Q1)

Concession schedule we can offer without escalations:
1) Small onboarding credit (20–40 hrs) + 2 months platform fee waiver for Option A if they sign within 30 days.
2) For Option B (upfront): 12% off platform list + 18% node discount + 120 onboarding hours + 6 months elevated SLA (4hr P1) for first year.
3) If they take >36-month payment term we can amortize additional 6% discount and introduce an annual price cap.

Rationale: Option B gives us cash visibility and lower long-term ops exposure; Option A is cleaner for their budgeting. Offering onboarding hours + shortened P1 for year one tends to close approvals for health sector.

Irene — confirm feasibility for the 120-hour onboarding and 4hr SLA (first year) from ops side?

—Rishi

Subject: ClearStream proposal: retainer vs upfront commit (summary + next steps)

Hi Marta / Kai —

Thanks for the patience while we pulled the numbers together. Attached are two short artifacts: the TCO matrix (pricing_workback.xlsx) and an updated SOW (ClearStream_SOW_v2.pdf). Below is a concise summary of the commercial options we discussed. Please consider this a firm commercial offer from Redwood that we can put into a DocuSign SOW pending your approval/redlines.

Option A — OPEX-first (12-month)
- Monthly platform fee equivalent: $29.2k/mo (annualized $350k)
- Node pricing: standard list; no upfront node discount
- Ops retainer: 0.5 FTE equivalent at $60k/year
- Concessions: 20 hours onboarding credit + 2 months platform fee waiver if signed within 30 days
- SLA: standard enterprise SLA; can offer 8hr P1 for year one

Option B — Upfront commit (preferred for discount depth)
- Upfront platform commitment: $320k (cash upfront) — net 12% reduction vs list
- Node pricing: 18% discount on node units with 24-month minimum commit
- Ops retainer: reduced to 0.25 FTE equivalent if upfront commit and 24-month term
- Concessions: 120 onboarding hours (SRE/eng) + 6 months elevated SLA (4hr P1) + migration support credit (one-time)

Extra incentives (if helpful)
- If ClearStream signs a 36-month amortized contract, we can add an additional 4% platform discount and cap annual increases at 3%.
- We can also include a one-time migration playbook + 30-day runbook handover as part of onboarding hours.

Next steps
1) Review the attached SOW (DocuSign link included) and mark any commercial redlines.
2) If Option B works, let us know and we’ll issue the DocuSign SOW with the 320k upfront line and the onboarding credit line items prepopulated: https://www.docusign.com/link/CLSTR-SOW-v2
3) If you prefer a joint call, I’m free Tue 7/20 10:30–11:00 PT or Wed 7/21 9:00–9:30 PT.

Kai — I left the financial terms explicit in the SOW so procurement can review quickly; happy to jump on a call to walk procurement through the amortization math.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
